g.text: OiSAM | Only its own estimated yaw is scored
Yaw error in degrees; dynamic-only support. Wen TC/GNC provide no independently estimated attitude result.
All saved yaw errors; no prior-only seeds, gap bridges or smoothing. O3286 marker retains usable but nonconverged status.
Oi uses 1/3/7 predeclared source-continuous blocks, not a single uninterrupted H/O run. Different inputs prevent same-input ranking.
